name: EasyEffects
author: Wian Schoeman
description: Switch EasyEffects presets from the Omarchy bar, and ten presets worth switching to.

barWidget.description: The active audio preset, one click from changing it, plus a bypass to hear the source untouched.

schema.label: Text beside the icon
schema.description: Show the active preset or the output device it is playing through. Vertical bars stay icon-only.

schema.label: Keep the bundled presets installed
schema.description: Copy the ten bundled presets into EasyEffects and keep them current. A preset you have edited is never overwritten, and a name you already use is left alone.

schema.label: Hide when EasyEffects is unavailable
schema.description: Leave the bar alone when EasyEffects is closed or not installed, instead of showing a dimmed icon that offers to fix it.
